result.stdout:
USAGE:
    Lib.Release.dll <Lib> [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

ARGUMENTS:
    <Lib>    Lib to release. Can be either name in default location or fully    
             rooted path                                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help         Prints help information                                  
    -d, --debug        Pauses execution so debugger can be attached             
    -v, --verbose      Sets LogLevel to Trace. Verbose overrides LogLevel if    
                       set!                                                     
    -l, --logLevel     Minimum level for logging. Verbose overrides LogLevel if 
                       set!                                                     
        --ApiKey       nuget.org api key for pushing packages to nuget.org. Can 
                       also be set as environment variable: NUGET_API_KEY.      
                       Explicit ApiKey set overrules Environment variable       
        --SkipTests    Skip running tests                                       

COMMANDS:
    releasecli <Lib>     
Exit code: 0
